title: Join PistonHeads at the 24 Hours of Le Mans 2026
content:
As the clocks go back and the nights draw in, our minds are already drifting to summer, and that can only mean one thing: Le Mans. Last year had it all: relentless heat, high drama, debuting hypercars, and even a marauding rabbit on the Mulsanne Straight. Ferrari claimed a third straight overall win, Robert Kubica finally nailed redemption, Aston Martin’s Valkyrie made its Hypercar debut, and Peugeot brought back its iconic GTi. Being trackside with PistonHeads made it all the more unforgettable, of course, from the new campsite to our sweltering Classic British Welcome and the return of the pub quiz.
And now, we’re looking ahead to 2026. The competition at the front is set to be fiercer than ever, with more manufacturers joining the Hypercar fray and fresh rivalries brewing. Expect speed, chaos, and 24 hours of pure adrenaline - you know, the sort of racing that keeps us coming back, year after year.
From June 10th - 14th 2026, we’ll be camping with our long-term partner 1st Tickets, bringing the PistonHeads campsite back for another year. It’s the perfect base, close to the action, full of great company, and packed with everything you need for a cracking weekend away.
You can expect all the usual perks, including:
-
Pre-allocated camping pitches - no need to rush; your space will be ready when you arrive
-
Cooked meals included - three full English breakfasts and three evening meals
-
Fenced perimeter for peace of mind
-
On-site security and night patrols throughout the weekend
-
Private toilets and warm showers, so no long queues for facilities
-
Large marquee with a cash bar, complete with live TV coverage of the race
-
Free Wi-Fi access to stay connected
As always, multiple packages will be available that include general admission, with extras such as pre-erected tents, grandstand seating and even helicopter rides available to bolt on.
Bookings will be opening soon. Spaces always disappear fast, so if you’re interested in joining the PistonHeads crew trackside next June, make sure to register your interest now. You’ll be the first to know when packages go live.
Le Mans 2026 promises another weekend of incredible racing, road trips, and PH camaraderie. Don’t miss your chance to be part of it. Register now!
